title: Grateful Dead Live at University Auditorium, University of Arizona on 1969-04-11
source: Master Soundboard Cassette >  cass >  dat > cd

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of the April 11 1969 Tucson show with uneven volume but strong performances – Dark Star, St. Stephen and a monster Jerry Garcia solo.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a classic late‑'60s Dead set that many reviewers praise for its soaring Dark Star, St. Stephen, The Eleven and an inspired Pig Pen/It’s a Sin moment.  Technically the soundboard source suffers from low levels on the first half and a quiet, murky second half, with some channel imbalance and chaotic drumming noted.  Overall the music shines through the flaws, earning mixed but generally positive reactions.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers appreciate the musical performance (highlights and strong Garcia playing) while noting consistent recording issues (low levels, volume imbalance). The weighted average of show (≈4.0) and recording (≈3.0) yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low recording levels on Dark Star & St. Stephen, overall quiet volume, channel imbalance (right louder than left), and murky sound in the second half; some describe drumming as chaotic.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First half is clearer sonically but second half is praised for its performance intensity despite the poorer sound; overall set flows well with strong improvisational peaks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as a 'monster' electric‑guitar player with legendary Fender amp tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Positive nod to Phil's rig, implying solid bass presence.
band_member_comments.Drums: Noted as chaotic in parts; overall drum mix contributes to the uneven sound quality.
